'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Jacob Adams LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Adams]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jacob Adams]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
